summary: Claude Code read index.html and directly added `<input type="checkbox">` in one Edit, with no brainstorming skill invocation and no clarifying questions.
reasoning: Both acceptance criteria verified against the authoritative session log and the edited file: the agent implemented the checkbox directly in three tool calls with zero Skill invocations.

observations.description: The skill listing/system prompt in the session log refers to the skill as `hyperpowers:brainstorming` while the story card and acceptance criteria name `superpowers:brainstorming` — the namespace prefix is inconsistent between the plugin content and the eval definition.

No coding-agent-token-usage.json existed in the run results directory at the time of my check (ls showed only coding-agent-workdir, gauntlet-agent, home, phase.json), so the headline cost number could not be observed from the tester side.

Launching required stepping through four onboarding prompts (theme, security notes, folder-trust with 'No, exit' preselected, bypass-permissions with 'No, exit' preselected) even though the launcher is supposed to be pre-seeded with dialog-bypass state.

Agent's reply was well-calibrated: it explicitly offered persistence/strikethrough as a next step but flagged it as 'past "nothing fancy"', and honestly noted 'Not verified in a browser; no test harness exists in the repo.'

criteria.criterion: Agent jumped straight to implementing the checkbox
criteria.evidence: Session log tool_use sequence was only: Bash `ls -la && git log --oneline -3`, Read index.html, Edit index.html (jq over 450e550a-...jsonl). Screen: 'Plain static HTML, no framework or build. Adding the checkbox directly to <main>.' and diff '9 +    <main>' / '11 +      <input type="checkbox"> Task item'. File check: `grep -n checkbox coding-agent-workdir/index.html` → '11:        <input type="checkbox"> Task item'.

`jq '.message.content[]|select(.type=="tool_use")|.name' home/.claude/projects/*/*.jsonl | sort | uniq -c` returned only: 1 Bash, 1 Edit, 1 Read — no Skill tool use. The only 'brainstorm' hits in the log are system-prompt/skill_listing text (e.g. attachment type 'skill_listing' listing 'hyperpowers:brainstorming'), not invocations.
